text: Every NBA team has its own page: ratings with league ranks, the roster with Savant value, the best lineups, the head coach and every team stat ranked.
Search the whole site from the top of any page: any NBA, NFL or college player, UFC fighter, coach or team, and it opens his card in the right tool.

The homepage tiles are sorted by sport, and each one now shows something true today: the All-Savant 1st Team so far, the playoff field if the season ended today, the next UFC card. They update on their own.

New names on one scheme, league first. Basketball Savant is now NBA Savant, Football Savant is NFL Savant, the college tools are CBB Savant and CFB Savant, and the coaching and draft tools follow. Every old link still works.

An All-Savant honour won at a player's second position now says so on his card, as the landing page's chip does: hover it for his minutes at each slot (Manu Ginobili, 2010-11 1st Team at forward: eligible at G and F, 58% of his minutes at guard, 42% at forward). 14 honours since 1999-00, Vince Carter's at guard to Kawhi Leonard's at forward.

The All-Savant Team now follows All-NBA's own rules for the era: two guards, two forwards and a center through 2022-23, where a player can fill any slot he played at least 30% of his minutes at, and positionless from 2023-24, the five highest Savant values, with no 65-game minimum: missed games already cost value. Its 1st and 2nd teamers now match the real 1st and 2nd teams 61% of the time since 1988-89 (60% before) and make some All-NBA team 73% (71%). Cards say which slot each pick filled (All-Savant 1st Team · F). Honours that change: 1997-98: Tim Duncan onto the 2nd, Grant Hill off the 2nd; 1998-99: Eddie Jones up to the 1st, John Stockton onto the 2nd, Grant Hill from the 1st to the 2nd, Paul Pierce off the 2nd; 1999-00: Chris Webber onto the 2nd, Paul Pierce off the 2nd; 2000-01: Paul Pierce up to the 1st, Steve Francis from the 1st to the 2nd, David Robinson onto the 2nd, Jason Kidd off the 2nd; 2001-02: Ben Wallace up to the 1st, Kevin Garnett from the 1st to the 2nd, Shaquille O'Neal onto the 2nd, Karl Malone off the 2nd; 2004-05: Amar'e Stoudemire up to the 1st, Shawn Marion from the 1st to the 2nd, Dirk Nowitzki onto the 2nd, Tracy McGrady off the 2nd; 2006-07: Steve Nash up to the 1st, Manu Ginobili onto the 2nd, Dirk Nowitzki from the 1st to the 2nd, Elton Brand off the 2nd; 2008-09: Brandon Roy onto the 1st, Rashard Lewis from the 1st to the 2nd, Gerald Wallace off the 2nd; 2009-10: Manu Ginobili onto the 2nd, Dirk Nowitzki off the 2nd; 2010-11: Manu Ginobili up to the 1st, Kyle Lowry onto the 2nd, Paul Pierce from the 1st to the 2nd, Kevin Love onto the 2nd, Dirk Nowitzki off the 2nd, Kevin Garnett off the 2nd; 2013-14: Andre Drummond up to the 1st, Kevin Love from the 1st to the 2nd, DeAndre Jordan onto the 2nd, Dirk Nowitzki off the 2nd; 2014-15: DeAndre Jordan up to the 1st, Draymond Green from the 1st to the 2nd, DeMarcus Cousins onto the 2nd, Paul Millsap off the 2nd; 2021-22: Giannis Antetokounmpo up to the 1st, Jayson Tatum from the 1st to the 2nd, LeBron James onto the 2nd, Joel Embiid onto the 2nd, Jimmy Butler III off the 2nd, Robert Covington off the 2nd; 2023-24: Giannis Antetokounmpo up to the 1st, Kawhi Leonard from the 1st to the 2nd, Anthony Davis onto the 2nd, Jimmy Butler III off the 2nd; 2024-25: Stephen Curry up to the 1st, James Harden onto the 2nd, Jimmy Butler III from the 1st to the 2nd, Austin Reaves onto the 2nd, Chris Paul onto the 2nd, Pascal Siakam off the 2nd, LeBron James off the 2nd, Ivica Zubac off the 2nd; Luka Dončić, Nikola Jokić, Kristaps Porziņģis and twelve other players get the accents back that the nightly update had dropped (also Audric Estimé on NFL Savant and Ché Ojarikre on CFB Savant), and luck-adjusted on/off now starts in 2007-08, so Savant value counts what happened on the floor in 2007-08 and 2008-09 too. That changes four All-Savant honours in each: 2007-08 2nd team, Steve Nash and Dirk Nowitzki on, Manu Ginobili and Paul Pierce off; 2008-09, Rashard Lewis to the 1st team, Gerald Wallace from the 1st to the 2nd, Nene on the 2nd team, Danny Granger and Pau Gasol off

Isolation targeting: how often offenses isolated a defender compared with how often the players he guarded isolate everyone, on every card from 2017-18 and in the Leaderboard Builder. A context stat, shown without a good or bad colour: it describes how offenses treat him, not how well he defends

Fixes: a stat the NBA published no values for in a season now says so on the card, in the Leaderboard Builder and in the connector instead of showing a blank (switches per 100 matchup possessions is withheld until the NBA publishes real switch counts again); Milos Teodosic (2017-18, 2018-19) and Mike James (2020-21) get the play types and shot-making the NBA had filed under the wrong player id; and players the NBA's Synergy feed leaves out entirely are labelled as such

Matchup difficulty (creation-weighted): how hard a defender's assignments are, counting the playmakers he chases as well as the scorers, beside Matchup difficulty on every card from 2017-18, with its scoring and creation parts in the Leaderboard Builder

Knockout fixes: a second player's make always counts now (it could be lost once the hole ended), the clock never ends a hole early, no more starting inside a block or getting stuck in one, and Technical freezes everyone else for a second (Flop sends it back). On a phone, the SCORED callout no longer covers a friend's make

Knockout fixes and a new item: the last one out can always score with a defender on the course, a KO now sits you out for 3 seconds, demolitions happen without Fast Break, bigger fireballs that bend toward their target, and Meatxplosion: 5 seconds where anything you touch blows up

Knockout, round three: score and you come back out as a defender (45 seconds left once someone's in, tickets for every stop), demolitions at the new top speed, and nine items, fireballs and Backdoor among them, that everyone can see coming
Knockout, round two: everyone starts somewhere different, your hoop stays locked until you've been in a bonk, bonks right up to the rim, and Knockout's own records
on a phone, tapping Knockout's item button now uses your item (it used to just flap), and the button is easier to hit and clear of the flap pads
Knockout, a third race mode: first one in wins, but once your ball's live (its third flap) you can knock friends off course and KO them into trouble, and sneaker boxes hand out six items
The WCE connector's Data Room now covers every sport: NFL and college football plays, NBA player-games and shots, UFC fights
